ocl.precondition: let u:User = User.allInstance()->any(o | o.UserID = uid) in let bc:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(o | o.Barcode = barcode) in (u.oclIsUndefined() = false) and (bc.oclIsUndefined() = false)
ocl.postcondition: let u:User = User.allInstance()->any(o | o.UserID = uid) in let bc:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(o | o.Barcode = barcode) in let valid: Boolean = (u.oclIsUndefined() = false) and (bc.oclIsUndefined() = false) in result = valid
